waitText: 已导入 2 条，跳过 1 条

eval: fetch('/api/recordings').then(r => r.json()).then(({data:d}) => { const items = d.items.filter(r => r.id !== 1); if (items.length !== 2 || items.some(r => r.status !== 'transcribed' || !r.transcriptChars) || d.hasActiveTasks) throw Error('batch transcription incomplete'); return d; })

fetch('/api/recordings').then(r => r.json()).then(({data:d}) => { if (d.hasActiveTasks || d.items.length !== 3 || d.items.some(r => r.status !== 'organized' || !r.summary || !r.categoryId || !r.tags.length)) throw Error('batch organization incomplete'); return d; })
